rationale: The agent located the user and reviewed orders, but it submitted a return without an explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the user’s stated initial request was to return the less expensive tablet with a refund to a credit card; the agent processed a return for a specific tablet with a refund to a gift card instead. There is no evidence in the conversation of the agent asking for confirmation and the user changing their mind, which would have justified the different item and refund method. While the final message aligns with the tool call made, the lack of confirmation and mismatch with the initial request mean the agent did not complete the request in line with policy.
